template_meta.title: Boat Rental
template_meta.description: Demonstrates advanced multi-day booking features. Includes a 'Pontoon Boat' with a minimum 2-night stay, a 1-day turnover buffer, and specific check-in/out days. Also includes a 'Speedboat' with a 3-night minimum. NOTE: After installing, you must create corresponding WooCommerce products and add dynamic pricing rules (e.g., weekend or seasonal rates) on the product edit screen to enable payments.

clisyc_boat.post_content: Perfect for family outings and leisurely cruises. This boat has a minimum 2-night rental period and requires a 1-day buffer for cleaning. Please note that check-ins and check-outs are not available on Mondays.

Ideal for waterskiing and fast-paced fun on the water. This boat requires a minimum 3-night rental. Dynamic pricing applies for weekends and holidays; configure these rules on the linked WooCommerce product.
